description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying invoices for a specific shop. It includes static parameter generation for dynamic routes, server-side data fetching (currently stubbed with static data), and rendering of invoice list UI elements.

methods.name: generateStaticParams

methods.name: ShopInvoicesPage
